name: Bremner Field
use: Lighted synthetic-turf field for athletics and Campus Recreation; community rentals

facts.text: One of four Campus Recreation outdoor fields (with Boulder, Memorial and Student Rec); surface ProGrass; 114,750 sq ft (425 by 270 ft); lit, open weekdays 6 am to 12:30 am.
Rental: UNH groups $153/hour ($195 with lights); non-UNH $215 ($280 with lights).
Campus Rec describes it as home to UNH men's and women's soccer and local youth sports.

verdict: A lit synthetic-turf field for recreation and rentals; useful, unremarkable.
notes: No licensed photo; the Campus Rec image is an action shot of a player (not kept). Build year, turf replacement history and namesake not found; old row's TNH 2022 "turf flagged for replacement" not re-verified. The soccer claim conflicts with UNH News (Oct 2025), which places men's and women's soccer at Tucker Field; the Campus Rec page is probably stale. Location per notunh gazetteer: north-west of Wildcat Stadium.
judgeNotes: Open-air field: unranked. Interior score is nominal.
